title: The Mystery Braid - How It’s Made - Leather Craft

meta.description:
Ever wondered how a mystery braid is made? In this leather craft video I show all the steps I used to measure and make this tooled leather braided band. A mystery braid project can be a great gift idea for someone, not to mention it’s also an awesome canvas for creative tooling and finishing. I hope you enjoy this leather craft video and I hope it takes some of the mystery out of making a mystery braid project.
